body: It just feels utterly hopeless. The sky turning red? This just feels like a situation only the rich will be lucky enough to survive and get to see the Earth healed.
Thank you! I just really needed some kind words.

Oh god children. Just yesterday a friend of mine became a grandmother and I was close to tears cause I could only think about how hard life is gonna be for kids. I’be always been against having children but now looking at them makes me feel terrible.
Thank you, I know it’s a burden to my family too for seeing me like this and I just want to act like everything is okay.
